exposure: type of cerebral palsy (spastic CP, spastic quadriplegia)
outcome: characteristics of children with cerebral palsy
cohort: The study included 1986 children diagnosed with cerebral palsy who attended a camp organized for children with disability at a tertiary care center in Assam, India.
finding: Spastic quadriplegia was identified as the predominant form of cerebral palsy, with home delivery and delayed cry being common historical factors among children with CP in Assam.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was the most common mode of delivery (89.3%) reported among the children with cerebral palsy.
cross-section timing: At the time of attending a disability camp
